```python
def evaluate(store, task, profile, compute):
    # Owner mismatch check - BEFORE any other operations
    if task.get('owner') != profile.get('owner'):
        raise PermissionError("Owner mismatch")
    
    # Version mismatch - return None without side effects
    if task.get('version') != profile.get('version'):
        return None
    
    # Build cache key with owner, profile.version, criteria_version, job_text
    key = (task.get('owner'), 
           profile.get('version'), 
           task.get('criteria_version'), 
           task.get('job_text'))
    
    # Use cache if key exists (handles 0/None values)
    if key in store:
        return store[key]
    
    # Call compute and cache result (exceptions propagate, not cached)
    result = compute()
    store[key] = result
    return result
```
